conditional_on: Run only after the completed robust campaign rejects publication. An eligible robust result instead goes to atlas staging. Never change the audited candidate in response to audit results.
reason: The fixed candidate passed all native guards but was rejected on the previous two-layout transfer batch. That attempt remains rejected. A separate prospective nine-layout audit estimates expected skill across the invented-surroundings generator, rather than choosing another favorable geometry after looking at validation. It is not independent validation of real planetary physics.
protocol: Run matched r38 and the single fixed r39 candidate at ds16 for all nine layouts with the unchanged strict numerics. Save every member and both mean-climate checkpoints. No interim selection, stopping for favorable results, parameter changes, added layouts, or second candidate.
native_gate: Recheck the original native1/2/3 cached identity and metrics and every original native protection against the canonical r38 reference. The original failed layouts17/23 remain reported as failures; they are excluded from this prospective audit.
ensemble_gate: The actual nine-layout mean climate must have zonefit no worse than matched r38 and strict-agreement loss<=0.01, with every observed numerical check passed.
uncertainty_gate: Additionally score each actual individual layout and form nine paired candidate-minus-reference zonefit differences. Require their mean>0 and the lower2.5th percentile of20000 paired bootstrap mean differences>0. Resample the sorted difference vector with numpy default_rng(seed394901). This tests expected individual-layout score, a different estimand from the nonlinear score of the mean climate; both gates are required. The bootstrap interval describes this generated-layout sample only, not real-world climate accuracy.
publication: Only passing the unchanged native gate AND the prospective nine-layout mean-climate gate AND the predeclared paired uncertainty gate allows staging, full climate/economic exports, asset/accounting checks and actual .bat-server browser verification. Preserve all preceding failures. Otherwise retain canonical r38. This audit has a fixed budget and no follow-up candidate or extra sampling.
